entries.note: Expiry coverage requires a contract-specific payoff model that this runtime does not implement.
Round-trip option cost requires contract-specific execution modelling not emitted by this runtime.
Convexity requires a contract-specific derivative payoff model that this runtime does not implement.
Maximum loss requires a contract-specific derivative payoff model that this runtime does not implement.
Hidden leverage is a bounded judgement not emitted as a typed fact by the deterministic runtime.
Ruin possibility is a bounded judgement not emitted as a typed fact by the deterministic runtime.
A valuation cash-flow forecast requires explicit forecast assumptions that the runtime does not emit.
Cost of capital requires a valuation model and assumptions that the runtime does not emit.
Failure probability requires an explicit probabilistic model that the runtime does not emit.
An implied valuation story is model interpretation and is not emitted as a deterministic typed fact.
Forward reinvestment requires explicit forecast assumptions that the runtime does not emit.
A target margin is a forecast assumption rather than an observed deterministic runtime fact.
